subtitle.en: 375–568 · the end of the Western empire as movement
subtitle.zh: 375–568 · 作为「迁徙」的西罗马终结

summary.en: Two centuries in which peoples, not armies, crossed the frontier: Goths fleeing the Huns, Vandals walking from the Danube to Carthage, Franks settling Gaul, Lombards taking Italy. Rome did not fall in a day in 476; it was absorbed, piece by piece, by people who mostly wanted to be Roman.
summary.zh: 两个世纪里越过边境的是民族而不是军队：逃避匈人的哥特人、从多瑙河走到迦太基的汪达尔人、定居高卢的法兰克人、拿下意大利的伦巴第人。罗马不是在476年的某一天倒下的，它被一群大多想成为罗马人的人一块一块地吸收了。

source: Ammianus Marcellinus; Jordanes, Getica; P. Heather, The Fall of the Roman Empire (2005); G. Halsall, Barbarian Migrations and the Roman West (2007)

text.en: The Huns, horse archers from the east, destroy the Gothic kingdom of Ermanaric north of the Black Sea. The Goths run west. Everything that follows begins with this push.
text.zh: 来自东方的骑射民族匈人摧毁黑海以北埃尔马纳里克的哥特王国。哥特人向西逃。此后的一切都始于这一推。

text.en: Tens of thousands of Goths ask to cross into the empire as refugees. Emperor Valens admits them; corrupt officers starve them and sell them dog meat for their children. They revolt.
text.zh: 数万哥特人请求以难民身份进入帝国。瓦伦斯皇帝接纳了他们；腐败的军官让他们挨饿，用狗肉换他们的孩子。他们起义了。

text.en: Valens attacks without waiting for reinforcements and dies with two-thirds of the eastern army. Ammianus compares it to Cannae. For the first time a whole people is settled inside the empire under its own kings.
text.zh: 瓦伦斯不等援军就进攻，和三分之二的东部军队一起阵亡。阿米亚努斯把它比作坎尼。第一次，一整个民族在自己的国王之下定居在帝国境内。

text.en: On the last night of 406 Vandals, Alans and Suebi cross the frozen Rhine. Gaul is open. The legions on the Rhine had been pulled back to Italy to face the Goths.
text.zh: 406年最后一夜，汪达尔人、阿兰人和苏维汇人踏过结冰的莱茵河。高卢门户洞开。莱茵河的军团已经被调回意大利对付哥特人。

text.en: Alaric's Visigoths sack Rome for three days — the first time in 800 years. In Bethlehem Jerome weeps; in Hippo Augustine begins The City of God to answer those who blame the Christians.
text.zh: 阿拉里克的西哥特人洗劫罗马三天——八百年来第一次。在伯利恒，哲罗姆哭泣；在希波，奥古斯丁开始写《上帝之城》回应把这归咎于基督徒的人。

text.en: Rome settles the Visigoths in Aquitaine as federates. A barbarian kingdom with a capital, a Roman legal code and Arian Christian kings — the template for the next century.
text.zh: 罗马把西哥特人作为同盟者安置在阿基坦。一个有首都、有罗马法典、信阿里乌派基督教的国王的蛮族王国——下一个世纪的模板。

text.en: Gaiseric ferries 80,000 Vandals across to Africa. Ten years later they take Carthage and Rome's grain supply; their fleet rules the western Mediterranean for a century. 'Vandalism' is their legacy in the dictionary.
text.zh: 盖萨里克把八万汪达尔人渡到非洲。十年后他们夺取迦太基和罗马的粮仓；他们的舰队统治西地中海一个世纪。「汪达尔主义」是他们留在词典里的遗产。

text.en: Attila's Huns, with Ostrogoths and Gepids, meet Aetius's Romans, with Visigoths and Franks, in Champagne. Both armies are mostly barbarian. The Huns withdraw; Attila dies two years later and his empire dissolves overnight.
text.zh: 阿提拉的匈人带着东哥特人和格皮德人，在香槟遇上埃提乌斯的罗马军和他的西哥特、法兰克盟友。两边的军队大半都是蛮族。匈人撤退；阿提拉两年后死去，他的帝国一夜瓦解。

text.en: Gaiseric's Vandals sack Rome for two weeks, methodically. They take the Temple treasures Titus brought from Jerusalem in 70, and the empress.
text.zh: 盖萨里克的汪达尔人有条不紊地洗劫罗马两周。他们带走了提图斯公元70年从耶路撒冷运来的圣殿宝物，还有皇后。

text.en: Odoacer deposes the boy emperor Romulus Augustulus and sends the imperial regalia to Constantinople: the West needs no emperor of its own. Contemporaries barely noticed. The date is a later historian's.
text.zh: 奥多亚克废黜少年皇帝罗慕路斯·奥古斯都，把皇帝的服饰送到君士坦丁堡：西方不再需要自己的皇帝。当时的人几乎没注意。这个日期是后世史家定的。

stops.w: Fall of the Western Roman Empire

text.en: Clovis the Frank defeats Syagrius, the last Roman governor in Gaul. In 496 he is baptised a Catholic, not an Arian — which makes the Gallo-Roman bishops his allies and the Franks the future of Europe.
text.zh: 法兰克人克洛维击败高卢最后一位罗马总督西格里乌斯。496年他受洗为天主教徒而非阿里乌派——这让高卢-罗马主教成为他的盟友，让法兰克人成为欧洲的未来。

text.en: Theoderic the Ostrogoth kills Odoacer at a banquet and rules Italy for 33 years in Roman style: Senate, consuls, Boethius as his minister — until he has Boethius executed. The Consolation of Philosophy is written in his prison.
text.zh: 东哥特人狄奥多里克在宴席上杀死奥多亚克，以罗马方式统治意大利三十三年：元老院、执政官、波爱修斯做他的大臣——直到他处死波爱修斯。《哲学的慰藉》写于他的牢狱。

text.en: Justinian's general Belisarius lands to take Italy back. Twenty years of war wreck the peninsula more thoroughly than any barbarian had; Rome changes hands five times and its population falls below 30,000.
text.zh: 查士丁尼的将军贝利撒留登陆，要收复意大利。二十年战争把半岛毁得比任何蛮族都彻底；罗马五次易手，人口跌到三万以下。

text.en: The Lombards under Alboin enter an exhausted Italy and take the north. The peninsula stays divided — Lombard, papal, Byzantine — for 1,300 years, until 1870. The migrations end; medieval Europe begins.
text.zh: 阿尔博因率伦巴第人进入精疲力竭的意大利，占领北部。半岛此后分裂为伦巴第、教皇、拜占庭三块，一直到1870年。迁徙结束，中世纪欧洲开始。
